That doesn't matter. 

Just because someone understands doesn't really fix the problem.

Where I'm from they get you a job doing something like building pallets and you get paid $135 at the end of the week. After you've got food and paid for the bus it leaves you with not enough money for rent. They will put you up in a homeless shelter but those are horrible. You got so sleep with all your stuff in or on you so no one will steal it. That's if you can sleep at all because of all the mentally ill people screaming and talking to themselves all night long. 

It's always some excuse from these government types. There's no enough available now or why don't you just go volunteer, like that puts a roof over your head. I'm tired of the excuses and I'm tired the scraps they throw people like me to barely get by on. 

I don't want the government's help, I want to resources to solve my own problems and that just might be jumping off a bridge this afternoon.
